title: Tizol's stink bomb during 'Mood Indigo' in Philadelphia
summary: They toothpicked Bigard's keys, and in a hot Philadelphia theater Tizol burst a stink bomb during the 'Mood Indigo' trio so that Bigard and Tricky blamed each other and left Whetsol playing alone.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: What did they do to you?

They put a toothpick under the keys on my clarinet and then when I started to pick it up to blow and nothing come out. And we did it to Hodges, did it to -- we did everybody. Everybody had -- Tizol, we played the -- we played a theater in Philadelphia -- I can't think of the name of it. Well, anyway, it's a small stage and in those days they was using klieg lights, you know. And Tizol was up on the ramp above right by the klieg lights and on the opposite side I was next to a klieg light, too, burning up like mad.

Well, anyhow, that's when "Mood Indigo" was getting real popular. So Arthur Whetsol and Tricky Sam and myself, we were the trio. We had to go in the front to play "Mood Indigo". Tizol was full of pranks. They had a little -- what do you call these stores that you can buy tricks and all that?

Yeah. So he went over and he bought some stink bombs, you know, but he didn't tell nobody nothing, see. So when we went out to play "Mood Indigo" he burst one back where he was because it was so hot. All he had to do was stand on it and it would burst like that.

So while we was playing, we started getting this scent, you know. So I'm looking at Tricky, Tricky is looking

at me, and Arthur Whetsol, he's so proper, you know, and he's looking at both of us. So when I had to wait for my turn for my solo I walked to Duke, I said, "Duke, you ought to be ashamed." He said, "Ashamed of what?" I said, "You did that." He said, "I didn't do anything." So I said, "Well, there's nobody else but Hodges."

So I walked over to Hodges and said, "Rab" -- we called him Rabbit -- I said, "Rab, why did you do that for? You ought to be ashamed of yourself." "Do what?" I said, "You know what you did." And he got angry with me.

Then the scent got stronger. It got to the first row of the people and the people began to -- everybody stirring, you know. And so Tricky, he got it too, and he started blaming me and I'm blaming him and Whetsol is blaming both of us.
So Tricky and I, we were laughing. We were laughing so much we left Whetsol out there by himself and, boy, you never saw somebody embarrassed, was him. He was playing "Mood Indigo" all alone.
Did anybody ever think of blaming Tizol?
Yeah, we knew who did it. Finally we did.
